text: Ball-handler drives baseline from the right wing and finishes at the rim.
High pick-and-roll at the top of the key, ball-handler splits the defense.
Ball-handler pulls up for a dribble jumper from mid-range.
Isolation on the left wing, step-back three-point attempt.
Post-up on the right shoulder, turnaround jumper over the defender.
Defender interferes with the shot, contests at the rim.
Ball-handler is stripped on the dribble for a steal in transition.
Free throw attempt after a shooting foul.
